html:
SMTO-GML-0001 — SMTO needs to know which Gmail account to use

GUID: 45723309-6ef5-4d94-af33-9be2dd10e039
Slug: gmail-account-ambiguous
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gml

What happened

  • You have more than one Gmail account saved in SMTO, and this request didn't say which one to use. SMTO won't guess, so it didn't use any of them.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open More options › Parameter Store and search for gmail to see the names of your saved Gmail accounts. Each saved account has its own name, and that name is how you point SMTO to it.
  2. Write your request again, type @, and pick the Gmail account you want from the list that appears. A mention tells SMTO exactly which mailbox to use, so it no longer has to choose.

What success looks like

  • SMTO uses the account you mentioned and doesn't ask you to choose an account.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't type passwords or app passwords into the conversation to identify the account; the @ mention is enough.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Gmail account resolution found more than one eligible Gmail or Google account and the request carried no single explicit or accepted account reference.

What this means

  • This retained Gmail diagnostic concerns account selection, not Gateway selection or credential expiry. Current Google account selection requires one eligible account; when several remain it returns a choice of account references. Older occurrences may not retain that list, so refresh it before choosing.

Why this can happen

  • The retained account selection is ambiguous. The historical occurrence may not contain enough facts to reconstruct its candidate accounts.

How to diagnose it

  • Open the current connected-account list and compare the Gmail account references with the account requested for this task. Select an exact eligible account rather than guessing from a display name.

How to fix it

  • Pass an explicit account_ref or an @ parameter reference for the intended gmail_account, google_account or gmail_app_password_account. resolve_account returns the eligible account references in the error details; refresh that list rather than relying on an older occurrence, and confirm the task uses the chosen account before mailbox work.
  • Select the intended Gmail account from the current connected-account list. Confirm the task uses that account before requesting mailbox work.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Account selection resolves the intended Gmail account without asking for another account choice.

What not to do

  • Do not silently substitute a different target for a saved run or move its existing execution authority.

Technical notes

  • Retained Gmail-specific alias has no direct current producer; current Google account selection rejects multiple eligible accounts.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
